text.tspan: Data source: Elections Canada (2025); "After a low-turnout election with a postal disruption, St. John's eyes election reform",
CBC News (2026); Élections Québec (2025); Elections Calgary (2025). **Federal election voter turnout was calculated as the
weighted average voter turnout for all federal electoral districts within the municipality.
